_comment: Resource guards enforced by security_agent's check_guard task, called from core.base_agent on every inbound /execute. Denylist semantics: a request with no matching rule is ALLOWED. Fields agent/task accept fnmatch globs ('*' = any); target_glob only fires when the request carries a target path. Edit this file then call security_agent's reload_guards task - no restart needed.

deny.reason: hooks/ is retired - guards live here now
